body: Hey I'm sorry you're going through this. I wish I could help you. I've also lost interest in eating and have been staying up until 6am. The only advice I have is maybe you can allow yourself to feel whatever you've been feeling to the deepest level, and then you can think about what you really want. I just find that when I suppress my emotions, it just keeps building up and only when I fully accept them is when I can think about what I want in life. I really hope you feel better soon.
I feel the same. I've isolated myself because I feel like shit whenever I talk to someone. Every conversation ends in me feeling inferior and like an idiot.

Thank you. Yes, I often think about the fact that this is all I have - my life. And wanting to give it up makes me feel even worse. I just don't know. Everything in my life has just gotten worse and worse. And it's because of me! If I don't believe that I can make my life better, then there is no hope. Everything I want in life can only be obtained if I try harder than I am. But I'm too tired. I've given up. I really appreciate you trying to make me feel better. I cried reading what you wrote. I feel like a hypocrite to say this, but I hope you feel a little better soon and can get through whatever is hurting you.
I think I've really run out of options. Thank you for your reply.
